Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 37 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rajesh - 36 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Ananya - 8 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Rishabh stands in the snow. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Anita: "Really?"

[Rishabh catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Rishabh: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh lies down on the sofa.]

Rishabh: "How beautiful!"

[Rishabh sits down on a chair.]

Anita: "That's great!"

[Rishabh flops down on the sofa.]

Ananya: "What happened?"

[Rishabh sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Rishabh (gently): "And then?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Rajesh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh claps his hands.]

Rajesh: "What happened?"

[Rishabh scratches his head.]

Rajesh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[It starts to rain.]

Rajesh (happily): "I'm ready!"

[Rishabh lights a bonfire.]

Rishabh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
